title: Principal quotient cone quasi-isomorphism for every K-flat
statement: Let R,S,φ,t satisfy the exact principal quotient sequence, and let E be the ordinary extension in a derived coefficient model with its normalized ordinary adjunction. The strict cone map C_t(P)→Res E(P), having zero shifted component and termwise adjunction unit as unshifted component, is a quasi-isomorphism for every K-flat complex P. Only exactness of restriction and the model preservation of quasi-isomorphisms between K-flats are needed.

source.place: Tags 06YP, 06YS, 06YY and Modules on Sites, Tag 03EK; normalized principal quotient construction.

proof.text: For flat terms the preceding flat-sequence result gives a degreewise short exact sequence. It is therefore a short exact sequence of complexes. Its mapping-cone projection is the strict augmentation, so Mathlib quasiIso_descShortComplex proves the assertion. Resolve any K-flat P by a flat-term K-flat K→P. The cone map is a quasi-isomorphism, as is the restricted coefficient map by preservation for K-flats and exactness of restriction. Naturality identifies their composites with the augmentations. Cancel the first quasi-isomorphism in this identity to deduce the assertion on P.

theorem chainAugmentation_quasiIso
    [PreservesFiniteLimits (restriction φ)] [PreservesFiniteColimits (restriction φ)]
    (P : CochainComplex (Modules R) ℤ)
    (hP : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (R := R) P) :
    QuasiIso ((chainAugmentation t _ (coefficientUnit φ d.E adj)
      (coefficientUnit_zero t φ d.E adj ht)).app P)
